mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) has a negative correlation with S&P 500 forward returns, such that lower values predict positive 20-day returns due to reduced discount rates for equity cash flows. This signal is always active as long as the rate is available.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3mo_MA, 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, as higher manufacturing output supports corporate earnings growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20d forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY change) signals central bank tightening pressure that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE decline > 0.3pp over 3 months) signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns during labor market recovery regimes.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE decline > 0.3pp over 3 months, 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A negative real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL YoY change < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint behavior of monetary and inflation indicators.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL YoY change < 0.5%, 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases over any 2-year window.
